The [WTA model rankings](/tennis/rankings/) publish weekly market-implied player strength, surface effects, uncertainty, and historical trajectories. The [model notes](/tennis/model/) describe the specification and fitting process.

The tennis-tracking project is **paused with intent to return**. Its framework, object-detection, pipeline, data, and liveblog posts remain in the [Archive](/archive/).
